title: Define fact belief memory rumor provenance

prior_private_draft.first_validator_diff_disposition: Withdrawn and not installed: its evidence-subset and inferred revision restrictions were unsupported by declared record semantics.

governing_sections.decision: Facts are objective truth, beliefs may be false, rumor hops transmit attributed claims without rewriting the original fact.
Episodes identify committed sources; summaries cover episodes and derived claims but remain derived aids. Committed facts and decisions remain truth and replay history.
Pure knowledge proposals pass through engine/session owner; accepted facts and decisions are committed atomically.
Current public records carry typed separate FactId and RecordId links; validator checks existence without equating transmission evidence to claim evidence.
Codec serializes full state and reconstructs through checkpoint constructor and exact resume pins.

source_policy.selected: Preserve separately attributed world fact, knowledge grant, false belief, later memory episode, rumor transmission and later summary. Independent accepted transmission event may be a rumor evidence FactId distinct from the underlying claim evidence FactId. The summary references episode and claim IDs without becoming a GameFact.

alternatives.option: Require rumor evidence to be a subset of claim evidence
alternatives.outcome: Rejected: accepted transmission event can have its own causal FactId.

alternatives.option: Require memory/summary source revisions to equal source fact revision
alternatives.outcome: Rejected: recording and consolidation may happen later.

alternatives.option: Treat summary prose as canonical truth

source_policy.unresolved: The current records do not alone prove audience/contact policy, semantic agreement of prose, or the complete propagation producer contract.

source_example.attributed_false_claim: I gained a resource; none was spent; evidence is outcome FactId
source_example.accepted_transmission: Separate causal ContentEvent FactId representing a speech event; same accepted decision in the synthetic fixture
source_example.rumor: Claim RecordId plus transmission FactId; sender and recipient differ
source_example.memory: Episode source is transmission FactId; recorded revision 1:5
source_example.summary: Covered episode and derived claim RecordIds; recorded revision 1:6; never copied into GameFact

implementation.change: Nested codec test module only; existing production prefix byte-identical.

assertions: Exact codec round trip and byte-identical re-encode preserve fact, claim, transmission, episode and summary IDs.
False claim and derived text edits do not alter facts, accepted decisions, resources, basis or pins.
Compaction of derived records leaves canonical history intact.
Missing fact, episode or claim IDs and duplicate episode identity refuse atomically.
Wrong admitted content digest refuses recovery.
